dialogues.speaker: Kapitan-Poruchik
dialogues.text: Like I said, this facility is property of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. External personnel are not allowed on the premises.

dialogues.speaker: Praporshchik
dialogues.text: It's all my fault, Kapitan. An outsider co-opting Design Bureau property... I can't believe such a dereliction of duty took place. I will get to the bottom of this.

dialogues.speaker: Kapitan-Poruchik
dialogues.text: No need. Just take your men and bring the facility back under control.

dialogues.speaker: Praporshchik
dialogues.text: What? So, no investigation? Is that an order from above?

dialogues.speaker: Kapitan-Poruchik
dialogues.text: Hm? When did you get here? This facility is property of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau. External personnel are not allowed on the premises.
